trailhead.label: Below Saltaus on path 1, about 300 m from the Hirzer cable car car park (official start)

cautions: The open irrigation channel runs right beside the path (water from early April to late October).
Rocky steps near km 1.1 and several small footbridges.
Slippery when wet, and not suitable for prams or wheelchairs.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
